parole.testo: Literally, “until the eternity of the ages”, a Biblical phrase (as in Daniel 7:18: Aramaic עַד עָלַם עָלְמַיָּא (ʿaḏ ʿālam ʿālmayyā)); compare also door de eeuwen der eeuwen.

parole.significato: iron law, irrevocable law (unchangeable, uncontestable principle)
parole.testo: First attestation of idiomatic use dates from the 18th century. From Aramaic כְּדָת־מָדַי וּפָרַס (“law of the Medians and the Persians”) (Daniel 6).
